releaseNotes: AURA 3.9.0 introduces a universal nested-routing workflow: map each track or bus as a node, assign its immediate PARENT, and choose one REF per sibling scope. Auto-Mix never compares a summed parent against its child audio, and a hot or missing REF pauses only its own scope. Sender instances now include a built-in measured AURA Trim, and persistent sender identities prevent row/REF drift after reloads. Deep Field adds a Genre EQ Guide with instrument-specific cleanup, masking, character, presence, and air ranges adapted to the selected genre. Guidance is advisory; AURA does not apply EQ or move DAW controls.
